scene.speaker: freya
scene.bubble: The sea is Pip's home! Waves, fish, little boats… and the lighthouse watching everything.

words.clue: Big, blue and full of fish.
You find it on the sand. It is pretty.
It has big claws and walks funny.
Yellow and soft. You make castles with it.

activities.title: Match the sea thing with its place.
Listen at the sea. Write a word or number in each gap.

data.voice_note: Voces: Freya (en la orilla) y Tomás (nadando).
data.script: Freya: The sea is so blue today! … Tomas: I can see three little fish! They are silver. … Freya: There is a red boat far away. … Tomas: I found a big white shell! Listen — the sea is inside! … Freya: Careful, there is a crab next to your foot! … Tomas: Whoa! Hello, little crab. … Freya: And look up — Pip is flying with two other birds. … Tomas: The sea is the best playground!

questions.q: There is a … next to his foot.

items.sentence: There ___ many fish in the sea.

data.text: Draw the sea together: each says one thing to add ("There is a boat… There are two crabs…") until the picture is full!

activities.title: Spot the differences!
activities.instructions: Look at picture A and picture B. Find the 12 differences and tell your partner about them.

homework.prompt: Draw the sea with 5 things and write: There is… / There are… for each one.

outcomes.puede: Understand short simple dialogues about family, school, animals, food (Cambridge Starters Listening parts 1–4).
Answer picture-prompted questions; describe a picture in simple sentences.
Read 2–3-sentence texts; match pictures to words and short captions.
Copy words and complete short sentences (Starters Reading/Writing parts).
~450 words (Starters wordlist); Present simple, present continuous (limited), there is/are, like + -ing.
